name: an_sum_fib_sq
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.fib i ^ 2 = Nat.fib n * Nat.fib (n + 1)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.fib i ^ 2 = Nat.fib n * Nat.fib (n + 1)
informal: Sum of squares of Fibonacci numbers F_0..F_n equals F_n * F_{n+1}.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.fib i ^ 2 = Nat.fib n * Nat.fib (n + 1)
